# [Jira all APIs are free or paid? if paid what are the paiment plans?](/t/jira-all-apis-are-free-or-paid-if-paid-what-are-the-paiment-plans/87575)

I want to integrate Jira into my project; regarding that, I am asking these questions.

Access to the REST APIs is free for all Jira plans.

Refer to [this thread](https://community.atlassian.com/t5/Jira-questions/Is-JIRA-API-have-some-fee-for-use-them/qaq-p/2444920) in the public Community Forum where that same question was most recently asked
